data.body: SDC1 approved as qualified on 2026-09-01: ticketize a dedicated child removing only dead ConcurrencyEvent, Result, rebase_retry, and _handle_failed_write_result. Defer RescheduleError and EXIT_RESCHEDULE to the ordered reconcile compatibility child. Preserve snapshot_head drift checks, live ReconcileLockLost -> RESCHEDULE, canonical bridge exit 0, store RebaseGuard exit 75, and migrate or retain a decoder for persisted reconcile-check state. Classified as hardening, not a demonstrated runtime defect.
